episode: Creating a MAN CAVE, Basement Finishing
source_audio: The master supplied for this Short has no audio track at all, one video stream and nothing else, so there is no transcript. Every line below is written from what is on screen and nothing is claimed that cannot be seen in frame. If a copy with sound turns up, the script is worth rewriting around whatever Mike actually says, because he almost certainly names the materials and the budget.
assessment: A basement that starts as bare studs and a concrete floor and ends as a man cave with a full wet bar, a television wall, a second sitting area and a bathroom. The signature image is unmistakable: a live edge walnut bar top with a blue resin river poured down the middle of it, lit from inside. That is the hook and it is the thing people will stop for. The finished footage runs 8:25 to 13:32. Everything before 8:20 is before, demo, framing and the counters still going in, and everything after 13:32 is the subscribe bar, the labelled montage and the statistics slide.

avoid_ranges.reason: before, demo, framing and drywall. The cabinets are in from about 5:40 but the counters are still being set through 7:15, so the room is not finished until 8:25
a like and subscribe graphic is burned into frame
the subscribe bar is burned into frame
the comparison montage with Kitchenette, Main Area and Bathroom labels burned in

project_context.summary: A basement finished out as a man cave. A full wet bar with navy shaker cabinets, glass front uppers lit from inside, stone counters and a veined stone backsplash, and a live edge walnut bar top with a blue resin river running through it that lights up. Yellow floating shelves are used as the accent through the whole space. Across the room a television wall built into matching navy cabinets under a walnut top. Behind that a second sitting area with its own television on a floating media shelf, and a full bathroom with a round mirror over the vanity and a tiled shower with glass corner shelves.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short, cut entirely from 8:25 to 13:32. No before footage, no progress footage, nothing from the labelled montage.
notes: Mike is in almost every frame of this episode and he works the middle and right of frame at the bar, so nearly every usable window is a left hand crop.
The lit resin river is the whole reason this Short exists. It opens on it and it pays off on it.

shot_notes: Clean windows found by scanning the reveal: the bar room held left at 10:22 to 11:26 (Mike stands centre and right, crops from 0.18 to 0.50 stay clear of him), the resin river close at 10:24 to 10:30 and 11:14 to 11:19, the backsplash slab at 9:30 to 10:05, the television wall at 8:26 to 8:44 held centre right, the bathroom at 12:04 to 12:20, the second sitting area at 12:45 to 12:58, and the far end of the bar at 13:14 to 13:30 held right. Everything in this Short comes from those.

shorts.full_vo:
This basement was nothing but studs and concrete. Now it is a man cave with a bar that lights up. Live edge walnut with a blue resin river.

Navy cabinets behind it, stone counters, and a veined stone backsplash. The yellow shelves are the accent, and they carry through the whole room. Glass front uppers, lit inside, with the glassware already in.

Across the room, the television wall. More navy underneath, with a walnut top that matches the bar. There is a second sitting area back here with its own TV and media shelf.

And there is a full bathroom down here too. Tiled shower, glass corner shelves. All of that in a basement that started out as bare framing and a concrete floor.
shorts.voice_direction: Warm and unhurried, a contractor walking a friend through a basement he is pleased with, and letting the bar do the talking.
